product: Evidence-based blockchain research and monitoring infrastructure
network_order: Solana first; Ethereum is the selected EVM scope; further networks require a bounded scope decision.

claims.label: Supported research
claims.detail: Solana mint and SPL Governance reads; Ethereum contract, issuer-freeze and LayerZero reads. Explicit parsers, source availability and per-route limits apply.

claims.label: Continuing research
claims.detail: Research records, saved comparisons and answer-to-source navigation. Unanswered requests retain a gap or reason; there is no general automatic research worker.

claims.label: Research graph
claims.detail: Joins one to four of an account's own cached answers. Typed relations and source conflicts remain visible; this is not a global multi-chain graph.

claims.label: Change checks
claims.detail: Solana and Ethereum watches re-read on request under published quotas; a watch with a registered receiver (at most one across the whole service) is also read hourly (see radar). This is not general continuous monitoring.

claims.label: Radar and webhook delivery
claims.detail: Hourly reads for one watched subject across the whole service. EXIT's own end-to-end test used the slot from 28 October 2026; on 11 November 2026 the slot was free (no watch had a receiver). Broader scheduled alerting is not delivered.

claims.label: Public evidence log
claims.detail: Append-only record commitments, daily anchor job and public verifiers. A checked inclusion proof establishes the commitment's presence by the anchor time, not the truth, completeness or earlier knowledge of its content.

claims.label: Paid API Pass
claims.detail: Receipt-to-credit production integration still requires its actual chain/wallet rehearsal and separate security and operating acceptance. Holding EXITP alone does not currently grant credits.

free_access: The initial period runs from 25 October 2026, 12:38:20 UTC, to 24 November 2026 at the same time. Existing keys then continue in the same quota-limited free service without a fixed end date or automatic payment. Daily quotas reset at 00:00 UTC each day. The service-wide lifetime totals of research attempts and of accounts (published at https://api.exit-protocol.io/v0/early-access) are never reset: once the attempt total is used up, requests that need a research attempt are refused, and once the account total is reached, no new key is issued. A reduction of the offer or an announced end of free access requires at least 30 days' notice; reaching a lifetime total has no notice period.
utility: Technical tests and operated routes do not establish independent human usefulness or commercial demand. These outcomes remain unmeasured unless a dated result states otherwise.
publication: This is a dated documentation snapshot (5 November 2026; the watch, radar and free_access texts were corrected on 11 November 2026, and the public CHANGELOG.md quotes the earlier wording), not an automatic live-status feed or an expansion of access rights.
